name: spt-fika
description: SPT AKI server backend with optional Fika mod (can be disabled on first run). Uses zedramus's docker image: https://github.com/zhliau/fika-spt-server-docker. Current SPT version: 3.11.3 Current Fika server version: v2.4.6 This is a barebones template to get your SPT/Fika server running quickly on Unraid.

paths.name: Server Files
paths.description: Location of required server files, user profiles, server (user/mod) mods, etc.

ports.name: Listening Port
ports.description: Leave this alone unless you know what you're doing.

variables.name: Listen on All Interfaces
variables.description: Sets http.json 'backendIp' value to 0.0.0.0, telling SPT to listen on all interfaces.

variables.name: Enable Profile Backup
variables.description: Creates a cron job that handles profile backups.

variables.name: Fika Version
variables.description: Override the Fika version string to grab the server release from. The release URL is formatted as https://github.com/project-fika/Fika-Server/releases/download/$FIKA_VERSION/fika-server.zip

variables.name: Auto Update SPT
variables.description: Container to handle updating SPT in your existing serverfiles.

variables.name: Auto Update Fika
variables.description: Container to handle updating Fika server mod in your existing serverfiles.

variables.name: Container takes ownership of server files
variables.description: If this is set to false, the container will not change file ownership of the server files. Make sure the running user has permissions to access these files.

variables.name: Container changes permissions of server files
variables.description: If this is set to false, the container will not change file permissions of the server files. Make sure the running user has permissions to access these files.

variables.name: Install Other Mods
variables.description: Automatically download and install any other mods as specified in MOD_URLS_TO_DOWNLOAD.

variables.name: Mod Download URLS
variables.description: Space-separated list of URLs you want the server to automatically download and install. Requires INSTALL_OTHER_MODS to be 'true.'
